responsibility: This option table defines command-line options for both the LTO front end and the lto-dump utility. It declares internal LTO driver flags such as -fwpa, -fltrans, -flinker-output=, and the resolution/output-list options, plus the dump tool’s symbol-listing, sorting, body-dumping, callgraph, and statistics switches, providing the generated option metadata and variable bindings consumed by GCC’s option machinery.
